title: Fire-Boltt Phoenix Pro Round Smart Watch 1.39" Display with Bluetooth Calling, AI Voice Assistant,SpO2 & Heart Rate Monitor, 120+ Sports Modes,IP67 Waterproof Metal Smart Watch for Men & Women - Black
bullets: 1.39” Ultra-HD Round Display Smartwatch – Experience a stunning 1.39-inch high-definition display with vibrant colors, smooth touch response, and ultra-clear resolution. This round dial smartwatch for men and women offers a premium look with an easy-to-read interface for seamless navigation

Bluetooth Calling Smartwatch with Built-in Speaker & Mic – Enjoy crystal-clear Bluetooth calling with an in-built microphone and high-quality speaker. Make and receive HD calls directly from your wrist, save important contacts, and use the quick dial pad for effortless communication.

Premium Stainless Steel Chain-Style Strap for an Elegant Look – Designed for those who value style, the Fire-Boltt Phoenix Ultra smartwatch with a stainless steel chain strap offers a sophisticated, durable, and fashionable design. This luxury smartwatch for men and women blends seamlessly with formal, business, and casual attire, making it the perfect accessory for any occasion.

AI Voice Assistant for Smart Control – Activate Google Assistant or Siri directly from your Bluetooth calling smartwatch. Use voice commands to check the weather, set alarms, control music, or get real-time updates – all hands-free

Advanced Health & Wellness Monitoring – Track your heart rate, SpO2 (blood oxygen levels), sleep patterns, and overall wellness in real-time. This fitness smartwatch with health tracking ensures accurate insights for a healthier lifestyle.
